title: Fix 'ACL packet for unknown connection handle' error
summary: If you see an error about an unknown connection handle for hci0, resetting the Bluetooth adapter usually fixes the issue.
error_patterns: hci0 ACL packet for unknown connection handle

steps.explain: Reset the Bluetooth adapter hci0 to clear the connection error.

rollback.explain: Reconnect your Bluetooth devices if they were disconnected by the reset.

warnings: This will temporarily disconnect all active Bluetooth connections.
